text: College students in California can register to vote using their campus address.
seenIn: advice overheard in a dining hall

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: College Students
truthSource.oneLine: Students may register at the address they use while at school or at their home address, but not both in the same election.

lesson.tip: “You have to vote back home” is common advice, not the rule. When someone sounds sure about an election rule, ask where they read it, then check the Secretary of State’s student page.
